Attention: NFC functionality is limited to iPhone 7 and newer models. iPhones can read NFC but not all RFID frequencies.

### Overview ###
• Manage NFC tags: read, write, format, lock, password protect, modify.
• Create custom NFC messages.
• Decode and design QR/Barcodes with advanced customization.
• Convert documents to OCR-enhanced searchable PDFs.
• Scan objects and rooms and generate 3D models from them.
• Send scanned data to your server via Webhook.


### NFC READER & WRITER ###
Interact with NFC tags effortlessly:
• Business Card, Web Link, Wi-Fi, Shortcut, Location, Text, Phone Number, Communication Apps (FaceTime, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram), SMS, Email.
• Expert Mode: NFC memory analysis, full/NDEF formatting, tag locking, password protection, and more.


### QR & BARCODE SCANNER ###
Easily decode and design diverse QR codes:
• Business Card, Web Link, Wi-Fi, Shortcut, Location, Text, Phone Number, Communication Apps (FaceTime, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram), SMS, Email.
• Supported codes: QR, Aztec, Code128, Code39, Code39Mod43, Code93, DataMatrix, EAN13, EAN8, Interleaved 2of5, ITF14, PDF417, UPCE, CodaBar, GS1 DataBar, GS1 DataBarExpanded, GS1 DataBarLimited, Micro QR, Micro PDF417.


### QR CODE STUDIO ###
Customize vibrant QR codes adding logos, emojis, and backgrounds for distinctiveness.


### DOCUMENT SCANNER ###
Capture and enhance documents with on-device OCR; save or share as searchable PDFs.


### 3D & ROOM SCANNER ###
• Scan an object and transform it into a 3D model with photogrammetry.
• Scan a room and transform it into a 3D model, identifying doors, windows, and furniture.
• Export models for 3D printing and other applications.
• Note: LiDAR required


### WEBHOOK ###
Send scanned NFC and QR data to your server with security and flexibility. Ideal for warehousing, inventory, membership systems, and home automation possibilities.


### WIDGETS ###
Access scanning tools or share QR codes directly from your home screen.


###SPEECH SYNTHESIZER ###
Hear NFC and QR texts in multiple languages and voices.


### THEMES & ICONS ###
Customize your app's aesthetics with a variety of colors and icons.
